content:
Riley T: Quick design sync: preview pane for alerts is misleading about send order. users set channel priority but preview shows last-modified first. noticed a support ticket where pager wasn't first. Priya S: Yikes. mental model mismatch. Two options: surface user priority or surface actual dispatch order. either way, label it clearly. Noah G: Accessibility note: do not visually reorder with CSS that rearranges DOM order. SRs will get inconsistent output. keep visual == DOM. Clara W: Backend facts: the runtime may insert fallback targets after failures, so dispatch != static priority. changing API is risky for some integrations. Riley T: Proposal: show runtime dispatch sequence in preview but prefix with "Dispatch order (first -> last):". Also list suppressed channels greyed with "suppressed until" text. Priya S: Agree. Copy for aria-live: "This alert will notify PagerDuty, then Slack, then Email. Suppressed: Ops-email for 2h." short and explicit. Noah G: Also include a small priority pill for context (sr-only label like "priority one"). ensure contrast. Clara W: I'll add a lightweight "preview_sequence" to the API: array of ids with state and suppressed_until_relative. front-end can use that and avoid client-side sorting. rollback plan included. infra-bot: Note: Console feature-flag required. rollout docs: https://go/redwood/console/preview-order. Riley T: Keyboard behavior: focusing the preview should land on the summary aria-live paragraph so SRs hear order immediately. arrow keys to move between channels; Enter reveals suppression details. Priya S: Tooltip copy for "Why this order": "Reflects runtime dispatch; suppressed channels shown greyed." Keep it one sentence. Noah G: Aria snippet to reuse: ```
This alert will notify PagerDuty, then Slack, then Email.
``` Clara W: We'll provide both ISO and relative suppression times in the API. frontend should favor relative for SRs. Riley T: Great. i'll mock the greyed suppressed row and the labeled dispatch header and post here for review. tagging @Priya S for copy review. :thumbsup:
